task: Unpack a closed, restrained cabinet kit and assemble its five-panel shell with twelve screws.
scope: Miniature tabletop cabinet shell assembled from five 3D-printed panels with metal screws; cardboard/paperboard packaging; no doors or shelves.
expected_status: succeeded only if every required check passes in an authoritative execution

S.initial_requirement: The closed box is already placed and restrained in a known nest. Autonomous receiving or box localization is outside this initial fixture.
S.terminal_requirement: Five assembled panels, all twelve required fasteners verified, no held component or screw, robot stopped at a defined rest pose, packaging accounted for in its collection area.

CabinetComponents.panel_revision: v0.3 adds printed grasp features to the v0.2 primitive panel envelopes; final manufacturing CAD remains to be produced

manufacturing.mass_source: unknown; obtain from a declared print estimate or physical measurement

CabinetComponents.geometry_interpretation: Panel solids describe external envelopes; they do not specify a solid-filled print or establish mass.

A.observations: No measured perception; animation state is authored.
A.execution_requirement: Observe IDs and outcomes after each operation; do not treat narration or animation as evidence.

M.model: generic XYZ carriage with orientable wrist, gripper and retaining screwdriver
M.actuator_targets: Stored separately from synthetic positions in generated dataset, with unknown measured telemetry null.

produces: all five panels staged and supported
twelve identified screws retained in carrier

requires: fixture available for each unsupported panel

required_execution_checks.expected: 5 panels and 12 unique screws accounted for
seal removed and all lid tuck tabs released without package contents damage
all lifts retain loads within machine capability
support verified before release and while fastening
all eight joints and twelve specified fasteners verified independently
reachable paths and tool access without collisions
all packaging collected and work zone clear
Before each authoritative lift, verify part/tool carried mass, centre of mass, wrist moment and grasp requirements against the selected machine/tool limits.

failure_policy.missing_component: blocked; do not proceed to assembly
failure_policy.seal_or_lid_jam: stop; inspect and retry only within verified force and retry limits
failure_policy.double_pick_or_slip: stop; place retained load in supported recovery location if safe and re-observe
failure_policy.screw_pick_failure: retry only after verifying empty tool and carrier state; never invent a successful pickup
failure_policy.unsupported_panel: do not release or attempt tool change
failure_policy.unknown_or_exceeded_payload: Block authoritative lifting until load and applicable machine/tool limits are verified. 3D printing alone does not establish a manageable load.

transfer_to_runtime.next_fixture: Physically characterize closure opening and one panel pickup, then validate a supported two-panel one-screw joint through the same contract before full assembly.
